event.description: The 2026 NC Transportation Summit is shaping up to be another outstanding gathering of transportation leaders from across North Carolina and around the country. Anticipating approximately 1,000 total attendees, including more than 200 NCDOT employees, along with representatives from other state DOTs across the U.S. and a strong mix of transportation industry professionals. This year also brings an important new dynamic to the Summit. For the first time, the new Secretary of the North Carolina Department of Transportation, Daniel Johnson will be hosting the event, creating a tremendous opportunity for the transportation industry to come together, build relationships, and demonstrate its commitment to NCDOT and the future of transportation in North Carolina. Please visit NC Transportation Summit for additional information. NC Transportation Summit banner image
